title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
abstract: arXiv:2611.34721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. translated_title: 基于特权在线策略蒸馏的缺失模态下校准阿尔茨海默病诊断
translated_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病的诊断依赖于临床、生物标本和影像学证据，但很少有患者完成全部检查。由于这些模态彼此互补，缺失的模态存在多种合理取值。现有方法大多直接舍弃缺失模态，或仅基于单一估计进行训练，因此分类器从未见过该模态的其他可能取值，估计值也从未依据诊断结果得到检验。我们通过在线策略蒸馏弥补了这两方面不足：模型自行填充缺失的模态，而拥有仅在训练阶段可获得的特权信息的教师对这些填充进行评分。我们的方法“特权教师分级Rollout插补”（Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers）逐模态抽取多个填充值。一个知晓诊断结果的插补教师对每一步进行评分，按照统计学实践的推荐将诊断结局纳入插补过程。一个能看到全部真实模态的诊断教师提供软目标。在多样化的填充值上训练，模型学会了能够反映……的置信度（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种在线策略蒸馏方法，让模型自行逐模态插补缺失数据，并由掌握特权信息（真实诊断结果和完整模态）的教师对每步插补和诊断输出进行评分，从而在模态缺失情况下实现校准良好的阿尔茨海默病诊断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an on-policy distillation method in which the model imputes missing modalities itself, one modality at a time, while privileged teachers—privy to the true diagnosis and all real modalities—grade each imputation step and provide soft diagnostic targets, yielding calibrated Alzheimer's diagnosis under missing modalities.
